note: What a server sends to place a region on the ground: a patch that grants sight, blocks the way, or grows cover. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: side
fields.note: The side the region belongs to.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What sort of region it is. A client makes one only for 0, a circle.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: The client id of the client the region answers to.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: The unit the region follows, or zero where it stands still.

fields.name: marker
fields.note: The name the region answers to, which RegionRemoved names to take it away.

fields.name: sightFrom
fields.note: The unit whose sight the region grants, or zero.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where the region sits, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: atZ
fields.note: Where it sits, along the other, in world units.

fields.name: lifetime
fields.note: How long it lasts, in seconds. A lifetime of 0 never runs out.

fields.name: lineOfSightRadius
fields.note: How far out the region's line of sight is reckoned, in world units.

fields.name: grassRadius
fields.note: How far out it grows cover, in world units.

fields.name: sizeMultiplier
fields.note: What its stated radius is scaled by.

fields.name: sizeAdditive
fields.note: What is added to its stated radius after scaling, in world units.

bits.name: lineOfSight
bits.note: Set where walls and terrain cut the region's sight.

bits.name: grantSight
bits.note: Set to turn on the region's sight; sightFrom and revealHidden apply only where it is set. Where it is set, a client clears its map's cover over the region.

bits.name: revealHidden
bits.note: Set to show hidden units within it, where grantSight is set.

fields.name: baseRadius
fields.note: The region's radius, in world units.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: Unused; a client makes a circle whatever it holds. A server writes 0.

fields.name: object
